# Fixture provenance

All frames in this directory are **synthetic**. They were generated by
`tools/make_fixtures.py` using `dcpstudio.mock.MockNetwork`, whose block layout
is implemented from:

- rt-labs p-net `src/common/pf_dcp.c`, `src/device/pf_cmina.c`
- Wireshark `plugins/epan/profinet/packet-pn-dcp.c` (IEC 61158-6-10 §4.3)

No vendor capture, production traffic, customer data, or real device was used.

The `session.pcap` contains:

1. one Identify-All request (Xid `0x11223344`),
2. three Identify responses from the demo devices,
3. one Get request/response for IP parameter, NameOfStation and Device ID,
4. guarded Set NameOfStation request/acknowledgement,
5. guarded Set IP parameter request/acknowledgement,
6. guarded ResetToFactorySettings mode 8 request/acknowledgement,
7. a rejected Set request/response (`apply_set=False`, block error `0x05`).

Regenerate with:

```bash
uv run python tools/make_fixtures.py
```

These fixtures validate framing, decoding, correlation, guarded Set/Reset
responses and PCAP I/O. They do not prove interoperability with real hardware.
Hardware validation belongs to `docs/lab-integration-tests.md`.
